shortDescription: Itochu Corp. plans to launch a tender offer for Dentsu Soken Inc. and take the company private in a $1.3 billion deal, according to Bloomberg.The transaction would end Dentsu Soken's parent-subsidiary listing structure with Dentsu Group Inc.

children: Itochu Corp. plans to launch a tender offer for Dentsu Soken Inc. and take the company private in a $1.3 billion deal, according to Bloomberg.
The transaction would end Dentsu Soken's parent-subsidiary listing structure with Dentsu Group Inc.

title: Itochu to Take Dentsu Soken Private in $1.3 Billion Tender Offer
